## Summary

I reviewed the saved unverified whole-building BIM (`seed`) against all six original drawings (1F/2F plans, North/South/East/West elevations) within the budget.

**Method:**
- Registered calibrated overlays for all 4 elevations (using wall-corner/dimension-chain pixel anchors from each original drawing, not fitted to the generated model) and compared them directly against `seed`'s opening geometry via `view_elevation_candidate`.
- Registered calibrated plan overlays for F1 and F2 against `1f_view.png`/`2f_view.png`.
- Sampled 10 same-space/separate-space observations via `check_source_space_relation` on both floors (corridor continuity, office/conference-room partitions, door connections).

**Findings:**
- **North, South, East, West elevations**: all opening positions, widths and heights (sills/heads, both floors) overlay very closely onto the original dimensioned drawings — no discrepancy warranted revision. F1 window height ≈1.60 m (sill 1.01 m), F2 ≈1.79 m (sill ~1.01 m above F2 floor) both matched the drawn 1600/1800mm + 1000mm dimension chains; the small F1:W4 south window (≈590 mm) also matched its own dimension chain.
- **F1 plan** (corridor + 3 north offices + 3 south offices): all sampled partitions/corridor continuity/doors matched the drawing (no conflicts).
- **F2 plan**: initial test observations conflicted, but investigation showed this was my own pixel/axis-direction calibration error (north-south sense), not a model defect — after correcting the calibration direction, the overlay and all 5 sampled relations matched the drawing exactly (2 conference rooms at north matching North elevation's 2 windows; 4 office cells at south matching South's 4 windows; corridor continuous; all partitions/doors correct).
- No supported discrepancies were found that required a `revise_bim` edit; all previously-reliable geometry, openings and connectivity were preserved unchanged.

**Unresolved / honestly out of scope (carried over from seed, not re-verified beyond the above):**
- Interior door heights (F1/F2 D1–D6) remain an unlinked 2.1 m assumption — no elevation shows interior partition doors directly.
- West vestibule/porch recess and SW wall notch are simplified to flush walls with single doors (not modeled as recessed sub-spaces).
- Furniture, and F1↔F2 vertical circulation (stair) are not shown in the supplied drawings and are not modeled.
- Room-use classification (`room_use_review`) was not filled in for the 14 spaces — this is a labeling/role task, out of this review's scope (partitions/openings/connectivity), left as-is.
- `input_view_status`/`height_coverage` still report all 29 openings as not formally "image-linked" in the tool's structured claim-binding sense, even though I directly visually verified every opening family against calibrated elevation overlays in this session.

**Delivery:** finished with candidate `seed` (unchanged geometry — no revision was needed).
